meta.name: defi-protocol-templates
meta.description: Implement DeFi protocols with production-ready templates for staking, AMMs, governance, and flash loans. Use when building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols.

copy.tagline: 用生产级模板实现 DeFi 协议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发区块链应用，需要搭建 DeFi 协议
copy.tagline_en: Use production-ready templates to build DeFi protocols
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building blockchain applications and need to implement DeFi protocols

howto.what: 这个技能包含写 DeFi 合约的代码模板：正文给出 StakingRewards（质押奖励）和 SimpleAMM（自动做市商）两份 Solidity 合约，并在 references/details.md 中注明还有更多模式。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建质押平台、实现 AMM、创建治理代币系统等 DeFi 或智能合约开发时，会触发本技能。

say.text: 帮我写一个带奖励发放的质押合约。
say.note: 会输出质押奖励合约代码。

say.text: 给我一个 AMM 自动做市商合约作为起点。
say.note: 会输出自动做市商合约代码。

say.text: 这个技能里有没有闪电贷模板？读一下详情。
say.note: 会读取参考文件来回答。

howto.what_en: This skill provides Solidity templates for DeFi: a staking contract (StakingRewards), a simple AMM (SimpleAMM), and more patterns referenced in references/details.md.
howto.when_en: Use when building DeFi applications or smart contracts, e.g., staking, AMM, governance, etc.

say_en.text: Write a staking contract with reward distribution.
say_en.note: Claude will return the staking rewards contract code.

say_en.text: Give me an AMM automated market maker contract as a starting point.
say_en.note: Claude will return the SimpleAMM contract.

say_en.text: Does this skill have flash loan templates? Read the details file.
say_en.note: Claude will read the reference file and answer.
